تكتسبين (form VIII)
# تَكْتَسِبِينَ (taktasibīna) /tak.ta.si.biː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِكْتَسَبَ (iktasaba)
# تُكْتَسَبِينَ (tuktasabīna) /tuk.ta.sa.biː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِكْتَسَبَ (iktasaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
